## 修复与改进

- 修复 ChatGPT 页面结构变化或只显示部分消息时无法保存的问题。保存以通过身份、分支和完整性校验的接口数据为准，不再要求页面显示全部消息或滚动到末尾。
- 页面能提供明确的分支冲突证据时仍会阻止保存；提交前再次读取接口并核对分支及内容，防止保存过程中混入变化。接口失败时不会静默导出不完整的页面内容。
- 兼容接口新增的分页辅助字段，继续严格检查历史覆盖范围。
- 状态页可查看和复制成功保存的脱敏诊断，方便确认数据校验结果；诊断不包含聊天正文、令牌或完整请求地址。

未能从页面确认当前显示的历史分支时，保存的是接口返回并通过校验的分支。

下载 `ai-inbox-browser-0.5.3.zip`，解压后将包内文件覆盖到原扩展目录，在 Chrome / Edge 扩展管理页点击“重新加载”，再刷新聊天页面。ChatGPT 兼容 Obsidian AI Inbox **0.3.0 及以上版本**；Gemini 和 Claude 需要 **0.5.0 及以上版本**。已满足要求的用户无需更新 Obsidian 插件或重新配对。

本版本仍为 Alpha。

## Fixes and improvements

- Fix ChatGPT saves when page structure changes or only part of the conversation is visible. Capture now relies on API data that passes identity, branch and completeness validation, without requiring all messages to appear on the page or scrolling to the end.
- Continue to reject explicit branch conflicts reported by the page. Re-read the API before submission to check for branch and content changes. API failures never silently export incomplete page content.
- Accept additional pagination metadata while retaining strict history-coverage checks.
- View and copy redacted diagnostics for successful saves from the status page. Diagnostics contain no conversation text, credentials or full request URLs.

When the page cannot confirm the historical branch currently displayed, the saved branch is the one returned by the API and validated by the extension.

Extract `ai-inbox-browser-0.5.3.zip`, replace the files in your existing extension folder, reload the extension in Chrome / Edge, and refresh the conversation page. ChatGPT supports **Obsidian AI Inbox 0.3.0 or later**; Gemini and Claude require **0.5.0 or later**. No plugin update or new pairing is needed if these requirements are already met.

This remains an Alpha release.
